title: Shesha-khanda, part 5 (portion 50)
html:
The section "The Lord Sees Vrindavana" (conclusion): Krishnadasa shows the Lord the Khadira-vana, Kumuda-vana, Ambika-vana and Nandishvara and tells of Akrura, the killing of Kamsa and Krishna's coming to Mathura; the Lord blesses Krishnadasa; the residents of the Mathura-mandala see Krishna in Him; the Lord sets out for Nilachala

Raga vibhasa; disha: "O Hari! Just once, only once, have mercy, Goraraya!"

ইহার ভিতরে দেখ এই খদিরবন ।
দধি-দুগ্ধ বেচিবারে রাধার গমন ॥ ৩১৬ ॥

ihāra bhitare dekha ei khadirabana |
dadhi-dugdha becibāre rādhāra gamana || 316 ||

ihara bhitare — within this; dekha ei khadira-vana — see this Khadira-vana; dadhi-dugdha bechibare — to sell curd and milk; radhara gamana — Radha's going

316"See — here within is the Khadira-vana:
[by this way] Radha went to sell curd and milk.

এইখানে শিশু লঞা কৃষ্ণের মন্ত্রণা ।
ডর দরশাহ—রাধা পাউক যন্ত্রণা ॥ ৩১৭ ॥

eikhāne śiśu lañā kṛṣṇera mantraṇā |
ḍara daraśāha—rādhā pāuka yantraṇā || 317 ||

eikhane — here; shishu lanya — with the boys; krishnera mantrana — Krishna's plot; dara darashaha — give Her a fright; radha pauka yantrana — let Radha be troubled

317Here Krishna plotted with the boys:
'Give Her a fright — let Radha have a scare.'

বনে লুকাইয়া শিশু মহাশব্দ করে ।
ডরে ডরাইয়া রাধা কৃষ্ণ চাপি' ধরে ॥ ৩১৮ ॥

bane lukāiẏā śiśu mahāśabda kare |
ḍare ḍarāiẏā rādhā kṛṣṇa cāpi' dhare || 318 ||

vane lukaiya — hiding in the forest; shishu mahashabda kare — the boys make a great noise; dare daraiya — frightened; radha krishna chapi dhare — Radha clings tightly to Krishna

318Hiding in the forest, the boys raise a fearful noise;
terrified, Radha clings tightly to Krishna.

রাধা কোলে করি' কৃষ্ণ বোলে—হায় হায় ।
চুম্বন করয়ে, প্রিয়বাণীতে বুঝায় ॥ ৩১৯ ॥

rādhā kole kari' kṛṣṇa bole—hāẏa hāẏa |
cumbana karaẏe, priẏabāṇīte bujhāẏa || 319 ||

radha kole kari — embracing Radha; krishna bole haya haya — Krishna says "Alas, alas!"; chumbana karaye — kisses Her; priya-vanite bujhaya — soothes Her with loving words

319Embracing Radha, Krishna says, 'Ah, ah!' —
kisses Her and soothes Her with loving words.

কৃষ্ণের পিরীতি পাঞা রাধিকা বিভোর ।
মদন-আলসে রাধা পাশরিল ঘর ॥ ৩২০ ॥

kṛṣṇera pirīti pāñā rādhikā bibhora |
madana-ālase rādhā pāśarila ghara || 320 ||

krishnera piriti panya — receiving Krishna's love; radhika vibhora — Radhika is rapt; madana-alase — in love's languor; radha pasharila ghara — Radha forgot Her home

320Receiving Krishna's love, Radhika is rapt:
in love's languor Radha forgot Her home.

এইখানে নিকুঞ্জেতে বিনোদ-বিলাস ।
প্রেমায় মুগধ দোঁহে ভেল মহারাস ॥ ৩২১ ॥

eikhāne nikuñjete binoda-bilāsa |
premāẏa mugadha doṁhe bhela mahārāsa || 321 ||

eikhane nikunjete — here in the bower; vinoda-vilasa — delightful pastimes; premaya mugadha donhe — both enchanted by prema; bhela maharasa — there was the great rasa

321Here in the bower are delightful pastimes:
enchanted by prema, both [danced] the great rasa.

এইখানে নাম হৈল মদনগোপাল ।
শুনিঞা আনন্দে গোরা বোলে—ভাল ভাল ॥ ৩২২ ॥

eikhāne nāma haila madanagopāla |
śuniñā ānande gorā bole—bhāla bhāla || 322 ||

eikhane — here; nama haila madana-gopala — [He] got the name Madana-gopala; shuninya anande — hearing, joyfully; gora bole bhala bhala — Gora says "Good, good!"

322Here [Krishna] received the name Madana-Gopala"1.
Hearing this, Gora joyfully says: "Good, good!"

দেখহ কুমুদবনে কৃষ্ণের চরিত ।
এইখানে খেলা খেলে বালক সহিত ॥ ৩২৩ ॥

dekhaha kumudabane kṛṣṇera carita |
eikhāne khelā khele bālaka sahita || 323 ||

dekhaha kumuda-vane — see in Kumuda-vana; krishnera charita — Krishna's deeds; eikhane — here; khela khele balaka sahita — He plays games with the boys

323"See — in Kumuda-vana the deeds of Krishna:
here He played games with the boys.

শ্রীদাম সুবল—গোঠে মুখ্য দুইজন ।
বালকে বালকে খেলা, কোন্দল তখন ॥ ৩২৪ ॥

śrīdāma subala—goṭhe mukhya duijana |
bālake bālake khelā, kondala takhana || 324 ||

shridama subala — Shridama and Subala; gothe mukhya duijana — the two chief ones in the pasture; balake balake khela — boys playing against boys; kondala takhana — then a quarrel

324Shridama and Subala, the two chief ones in the pasture —
in the boys' game against each other a quarrel arose then;

কোন্দলিয়া নাম স্থান তেঞি ত ইহার ।
কহিল কুমুদ-নাম-বনের বিহার ॥ ৩২৫ ॥

kondaliẏā nāma sthāna teñi ta ihāra |
kahila kumuda-nāma-banera bihāra || 325 ||

kondaliya nama sthana — the place named Kondaliya; tenyi ta ihara — that is why it is [so called]; kahila — I have told; kumuda-nama-vanera vihara — the pastimes in the forest named Kumuda

325that is why this place is called Kondaliya [— 'the place of the quarrel'].
I have told of the pastimes in the forest named Kumuda.

অম্বিকার বন দেখ সরস্বতী-তীরে ।
এথা হরগৌরী গোপ-গোপী পূজা করে ॥ ৩২৬ ॥

ambikāra bana dekha sarasbatī-tīre |
ethā haragaurī gopa-gopī pūjā kare || 326 ||

ambikara vana dekha — see the forest of Ambika; sarasvati-tire — on the bank of the Sarasvati; etha — here; hara-gauri gopa-gopi puja kare — the cowherd men and women worship Hara and Gauri

326See — the forest of Ambika on the bank of the Sarasvati:
here the cowherd men and women worship Hara and Gauri.

অঙ্গিরা-পুত্রেরে উপহাসের কারণ ।
সর্পদেহ ছিল বিদ্যাধর সুদর্শন ॥ ৩২৭ ॥

aṅgirā-putrere upahāsera kāraṇa |
sarpadeha chila bidyādhara sudarśana || 327 ||

angira-putrere — at the sons of Angira; upahasera karana — because of mockery; sarpa-deha chhila — was in a serpent's body; vidyadhara sudarshana — the vidyadhara Sudarshana

327For mocking the sons of Angira
the vidyadhara Sudarshana was in a serpent's body;

শাপান্ত-কারণে সেই নন্দকে গিলিল ।
উগারিল নন্দে, কৃষ্ণ-চরণে ছুঁইল ॥ ৩২৮ ॥

śāpānta-kāraṇe sei nandake gilila |
ugārila nande, kṛṣṇa-caraṇe chuṁila || 328 ||

shapanta-karane — to end the curse; sei nandake gilila — he swallowed Nanda; ugarila nande — he disgorged Nanda; krishna-charane chhuila — he touched Krishna's feet

328to end the curse he swallowed Nanda —
[and] disgorged Nanda, touching Krishna's feet.

কুবেরের চর শঙ্খচূড়ের মরণ ।
মাথায় মুষ্টিকাঘাতে মণির গ্রহণ ॥ ৩২৯ ॥

kuberera cara śaṅkhacūṛera maraṇa |
māthāẏa muṣṭikāghāte maṇira grahaṇa || 329 ||

kuverera chara — Kuvera's servant; shankhachudera marana — the death of Shankhachuda; mathaya mushtika-ghate — by a blow of the fist on the head; manira grahana — the taking of the jewel

329[Here is] the death of Shankhachuda, Kuvera's servant:
with a blow of the fist on his head [Krishna] took [his] jewel.

অরিষ্ট-বৃষভ-শৃঙ্গ চরণে ধরিয়া ।
মুখে রক্ত তোলে, গোঠে মাইল আছাড়িয়া ॥ ৩৩০ ॥

ariṣṭa-bṛṣabha-śṛṅga caraṇe dhariẏā |
mukhe rakta tole, goṭhe māila āchāṛiẏā || 330 ||

arishta-vrishabha-shringa — the bull Arishta by the horns; charane dhariya — and seizing by the legs; mukhe rakta tole — blood gushed from his mouth; gothe maila achhadiya — He killed him in the pasture, dashing him down

330Seizing the bull Arishta by the horns and legs,
[Krishna] dashed him down in the pasture and killed him — blood gushed from his mouth.

নারদ-বচনে কংস চিন্তায়ে বিমন ।
বসুদেব-দেবকীর নিগড়-বন্ধন ॥ ৩৩১ ॥

nārada-bacane kaṃsa cintāẏe bimana |
basudeba-debakīra nigaṛa-bandhana || 331 ||

narada-vachane — at Narada's words; kamsa chintaye vimana — Kamsa is troubled; vasudeva-devakira — of Vasudeva and Devaki; nigada-bandhana — binding in fetters

331At Narada's words Kamsa grew troubled
[and] bound Vasudeva and Devaki in fetters.

অশ্বরূপ ধরে কেশী কংস-অনুচর ।
মহাতেজ কৃষ্ণবর্ণ দেখি' লাগে ডর ॥ ৩৩২ ॥

aśbarūpa dhare keśī kaṃsa-anucara |
mahāteja kṛṣṇabarṇa dekhi' lāge ḍara || 332 ||

ashva-rupa dhare — takes the form of a horse; keshi kamsa-anuchara — Keshi, Kamsa's follower; mahateja krishna-varna — mighty, black; dekhi lage dara — seeing him, one feels fear

332Keshi, Kamsa's follower, takes the form of a horse —
mighty, black: the sight of him strikes fear.

বায়ু বন্ধ করি' তার মুখে ভরি' হাথ ।
এইখানে কেশি-বধ কৈল গোপীনাথ ॥ ৩৩৩ ॥

bāẏu bandha kari' tāra mukhe bhari' hātha |
eikhāne keśi-badha kaila gopīnātha || 333 ||

vayu bandha kari — stopping his breath; tara mukhe bhari hatha — thrusting His arm into his mouth; eikhane — here; keshi-vadha kaila gopinatha — Gopinatha slew Keshi

333Thrusting His arm into his mouth [and] stopping his breath,
here Gopinatha slew Keshi.

মেষরূপে শিশু চুরি করয়ে অসুর ।
পাথর আচ্ছাদি' রাখে পর্বত-গহ্বর ॥ ৩৩৪ ॥

meṣarūpe śiśu curi karaẏe asura |
pāthara ācchādi' rākhe parbata-gahbara || 334 ||

mesha-rupe — in the form of a ram; shishu churi karaye asura — the asura steals the boys; pathara achchhadi — covering with a stone; rakhe parvata-gahvara — keeps them in a mountain cave

334An asura in the form of a ram steals the boys
and, closing it with a stone, keeps them in a mountain cave.

আনিলেন শিশু, ব্যোম আছাড়ি' মারিয়া ।
আনন্দে খেলায় খেলা দুষ্ট নিবারিয়া ॥ ৩৩৫ ॥

ānilena śiśu, byoma āchāṛi' māriẏā |
ānande khelāẏa khelā duṣṭa nibāriẏā || 335 ||

anilena shishu — He brought back the boys; vyoma achhadi mariya — killing Vyoma by dashing him down; anande khelaya khela — He plays joyfully; dushta nivariya — having removed the villain

335Killing Vyoma by dashing him down, [Krishna] brought back the boys
and, rid of the villain, plays joyfully2.

তবে ত নন্দের ঘর ছিল নন্দীশ্বর ।
ইহার পশ্চিমে দেখ কাম্যকবন আর ॥ ৩৩৬ ॥

tabe ta nandera ghara chila nandīśbara |
ihāra paścime dekha kāmyakabana āra || 336 ||

tabe ta — then; nandera ghara chhila nandishvara — Nanda's house was at Nandishvara; ihara pashchime — west of it; dekha kamyaka-vana ara — see also the Kamyaka-vana

336Then Nanda's house was at Nandishvara;
see — west of here is also the Kamyaka-vana.

পিছলি পাথর দেখ এ গোপ-ছাওয়ালে ।
পিছলি খেলায় এথা বিহান-বিকালে ॥ ৩৩৭ ॥

pichali pāthara dekha e gopa-chāoẏāle |
pichali khelāẏa ethā bihāna-bikāle || 337 ||

pichhali pathara dekha — see the sliding stone; e gopa-chhaoyale — these cowherd boys; pichhali khelaya etha — slide down here in play; vihana-vikale — morning and evening

337See — the sliding stone: these cowherd boys
slide down it here in play morning and evening3.

পাবন-সরোবর নন্দীশ্বরের উত্তরে ।
চৌদিগে দেখহ খুঁটা বান্ধিতে বাছুরে ॥ ৩৩৮ ॥

pābana-sarobara nandīśbarera uttare |
caudige dekhaha khuṁṭā bāndhite bāchure || 338 ||

pavana-sarovara — the Pavana-sarovara; nandishvarera uttare — north of Nandishvara; chaudige dekhaha khunta — see, posts all around; bandhite bachhure — for tying the calves

338North of Nandishvara is the Pavana-sarovara;
see — all around are posts for tying the calves.

মথুরাতে অক্রূরকে কংসের আদেশ ।
সেইখানে সন্ধ্যাকালে নগর-প্রবেশ ॥ ৩৩৯ ॥

mathurāte akrūrake kaṃsera ādeśa |
seikhāne sandhyākāle nagara-prabeśa || 339 ||

mathurate — in Mathura; akrurake kamsera adesha — Kamsa's order to Akrura; seikhane — there; sandhya-kale — at dusk; nagara-pravesha — the entry into the village

339In Mathura Kamsa gave his order to Akrura —
and he entered [this] village at dusk4.

পথেতে আসিতে যত মনঃকথা ছিল ।
পদারবিন্দের চিহ্ন দেখি' সিদ্ধ হৈল ॥ ৩৪০ ॥

pathete āsite yata manaḥkathā chila |
padārabindera cihna dekhi' siddha haila || 340 ||

pathete asite — on the way here; yata manah-katha chhila — all the thoughts he had; padaravindera chihna dekhi — seeing the marks of the lotus feet; siddha haila — were fulfilled

340All the thoughts he had on the way here
were fulfilled when he saw the marks of the lotus feet.

এই গোঠে রামকৃষ্ণ দোঁহাকে দেখিয়া ।
দণ্ডবত করে ভূমে চরণে পড়িয়া ॥ ৩৪১ ॥

ei goṭhe rāmakṛṣṇa doṁhāke dekhiẏā |
daṇḍabata kare bhūme caraṇe paṛiẏā || 341 ||

ei gothe — in this pasture; rama-krishna donhake dekhiya — seeing both Rama and Krishna; dandavata kare bhume — he prostrates on the ground; charane padiya — falling at their feet

341In this pasture, seeing both Rama and Krishna,
he prostrated on the ground, falling at Their feet.

ঘরে লঞা গেলা তারে করিয়া আদর ।
রজনীতে কংস-মর্ম কহিল সকল ॥ ৩৪২ ॥

ghare lañā gelā tāre kariẏā ādara |
rajanīte kaṃsa-marma kahila sakala || 342 ||

ghare lanya gela — they took him home; tare kariya adara — honouring him; rajanite — at night; kamsa-marma kahila sakala — he told all of Kamsa's design

342They took him home with honour,
and at night he told all of Kamsa's design.

প্রভাতে ঘোষণা নন্দ দিলেন সভারে ।
ঘোষণা পড়িল—যাব কংসে ভেটিবারে ॥ ৩৪৩ ॥

prabhāte ghoṣaṇā nanda dilena sabhāre |
ghoṣaṇā paṛila—yāba kaṃse bheṭibāre || 343 ||

prabhate — in the morning; ghoshana nanda dilena sabhare — Nanda made a proclamation to all; ghoshana padila — the word went round; yaba kamse bhetibare — we go to present tribute to Kamsa

343In the morning Nanda proclaimed to all —
the word went round: 'Let us go to Kamsa with tribute.'

এইখানে রামকৃষ্ণ চড়িলা ত রথে ।
রাজ-দরশনে চলে অক্রূর সহিতে ॥ ৩৪৪ ॥

eikhāne rāmakṛṣṇa caṛilā ta rathe |
rāja-daraśane cale akrūra sahite || 344 ||

eikhane — here; rama-krishna chadila ta rathe — Rama and Krishna mounted the chariot; raja-darashane chale — they go to see the king; akrura sahite — with Akrura

344Here Rama and Krishna mounted the chariot
and go to the king together with Akrura.

এইখানে গোপীগণ মরয়ে কান্দিয়া ।
কৃষ্ণের বিরহে কান্দে অঙ্গ আছাড়িয়া ॥ ৩৪৫ ॥

eikhāne gopīgaṇa maraẏe kāndiẏā |
kṛṣṇera birahe kānde aṅga āchāṛiẏā || 345 ||

eikhane — here; gopigana maraye kandiya — the gopis are dying of weeping; krishnera virahe — in separation from Krishna; kande anga achhadiya — they weep, flinging themselves down

345Here the gopis are dying of weeping:
in separation from Krishna they weep, flinging themselves down.

ভূমিতে পড়িয়া কান্দে, আউলাইল কেশ ।
বসন-ভূষণ সব ব্যস্ত, ভেল বেশ ॥ ৩৪৬ ॥

bhūmite paṛiẏā kānde, āulāila keśa |
basana-bhūṣaṇa saba byasta, bhela beśa || 346 ||

bhumite padiya kande — fallen on the ground they weep; aulaila kesha — their hair dishevelled; vasana-bhushana saba vyasta — clothes and ornaments all in disarray; bhela vesha — such became their attire

346Fallen on the ground they weep, their hair dishevelled,
clothes and ornaments all in disarray — such became their attire.

তাহার কান্দনা মুখে কহনে না যায় ।
প্রাণহীন দেহ যেন রহে হাথ পায় ॥ ৩৪৭ ॥

tāhāra kāndanā mukhe kahane nā yāẏa |
prāṇahīna deha yena rahe hātha pāẏa || 347 ||

tahara kandana — their weeping; mukhe kahane na yaya — cannot be told in words; pranahina deha yena — like a lifeless body; rahe hatha paya — their hands and feet lie still

347Their weeping cannot be told in words:
like a lifeless body, their hands and feet lie still.

দূতদ্বারে কৃষ্ণ সে আপনে শান্ত করে ।
আসিতেছি আমি কথো দিবস ভিতরে ॥ ৩৪৮ ॥

dūtadbāre kṛṣṇa se āpane śānta kare |
āsitechi āmi katho dibasa bhitare || 348 ||

duta-dvare — through a messenger; krishna se apane shanta kare — Krishna Himself consoles them; asitechhi ami — I am coming; katho divasa bhitare — within a few days

348Through a messenger Krishna Himself consoles them:
'I shall come within a few days5.

তোমরা সকলে মোর প্রাণের সমান ।
প্রাণ ছাড়া দেহ রহে—এ নহে প্রমাণ ॥ ৩৪৯ ॥

tomarā sakale mora prāṇera samāna |
prāṇa chāṛā deha rahe—e nahe pramāṇa || 349 ||

tomara sakale — all of you; mora pranera samana — are as dear to Me as life; prana chhada deha rahe — that a body lives without its life; e nahe pramana — this is not possible

349All of you are as dear to Me as life —
that a body should live without its life cannot be.

দুষ্টগণ নাশ করি' শীঘ্র সে আসিব ।
দুঃখ না ভাবিহ, জান স্বরূপে এ সব ॥ ৩৫০ ॥

duṣṭagaṇa nāśa kari' śīghra se āsiba |
duḥkha nā bhābiha, jāna sbarūpe e saba || 350 ||

dushtagana nasha kari — destroying the wicked; shighra se asiba — I shall come soon; duhkha na bhaviha — do not grieve; jana svarupe e saba — know all this truly

350When I have destroyed the wicked, I shall come soon;
do not grieve; know all this to be true.'

এখানে গোয়ালা সব শকটে চড়িল ।
মানসগঙ্গার ঘাটে সভাই জিরাইল ॥ ৩৫১ ॥

ekhāne goẏālā saba śakaṭe caṛila |
mānasagaṅgāra ghāṭe sabhāi jirāila || 351 ||

ekhane — here; goyala saba shakate chadila — all the cowherds mounted the carts; manasa-gangara ghate — at the ghata of the Manasa-Ganga; sabhai jiraila — all rested

351Here all the cowherds mounted the carts
and all rested at the ghata of the Manasa-Ganga.

যমুনার ঘাটে গেলা আড়াই-প্রহর ।
স্নান-ফলাহার কৈলা গোয়ালা সকল ॥ ৩৫২ ॥

yamunāra ghāṭe gelā āṛāi-prahara |
snāna-phalāhāra kailā goẏālā sakala || 352 ||

yamunara ghate gela — they reached the Yamuna ghata; adai-prahara — at two and a half praharas; snana-phalahara kaila — bathed and ate fruit; goyala sakala — all the cowherds

352They reached the Yamuna ghata at the middle of the third prahara;
all the cowherds bathed and ate fruit.

অক্রূরের স্নানকালে বিভূতি দেখায় ।
বিকালে নন্দাদি আগে, পাছে কৃষ্ণ যায় ॥ ৩৫৩ ॥

akrūrera snānakāle bibhūti dekhāẏa |
bikāle nandādi āge, pāche kṛṣṇa yāẏa || 353 ||

akrurera snana-kale — when Akrura bathed; vibhuti dekhaya — He shows [His] glory; vikale — in the afternoon; nandadi age — Nanda and the rest ahead; pachhe krishna yaya — Krishna goes behind

353When Akrura bathed, [Krishna] showed [him His] glory;
in the afternoon Nanda and the others go ahead, and Krishna behind.

এইখানে হাহাকার কৈল সব লোক ।
এ মল্লের যোগ্য নহে—এ অতি বালক ॥ ৩৫৪ ॥

eikhāne hāhākāra kaila saba loka |
e mallera yogya nahe—e ati bālaka || 354 ||

eikhane — here; hahakara kaila saba loka — all the people cried out in dismay; e mallera yogya nahe — He is no match for a wrestler; e ati balaka — He is a mere boy

354Here all the people cried out in dismay:
'He is no match for a wrestler — He is a mere boy!

অযোগ্য করয়ে কংস, করয়ে বিরূপ ।
যার যেন হিয়া, কৃষ্ণে দেখে তেনরূপ ॥ ৩৫৫ ॥

ayogya karaẏe kaṃsa, karaẏe birūpa |
yāra yena hiẏā, kṛṣṇe dekhe tenarūpa || 355 ||

ayogya karaye kamsa — Kamsa acts unfittingly; karaye virupa — acts wrongly; yara yena hiya — as each one's heart is; krishne dekhe tenarupa — so he sees Krishna

355Kamsa acts unfittingly, acts wrongly!'
As each one's heart was, so he saw Krishna6.

চমকিত ভেল কংস, সঘনে ভরম ।
কৃষ্ণ-বলরামে দেখে মূর্তিমন্ত যম ॥ ৩৫৬ ॥

camakita bhela kaṃsa, saghane bharama |
kṛṣṇa-balarāme dekhe mūrtimanta yama || 356 ||

chamakita bhela kamsa — Kamsa was startled; saghane bharama — in deep confusion; krishna-balarame dekhe — in Krishna and Balarama he sees; murtimanta yama — Death embodied

356Kamsa was startled, in deep confusion:
in Krishna and Balarama he sees Death embodied.

মল্লগণ দেখে যেন বজ্র-নিরমাণ ।
যোগিগণ দেখে সেই পূর্ণ ভগবান্ ॥ ৩৫৭ ॥

mallagaṇa dekhe yena bajra-niramāṇa |
yogigaṇa dekhe sei pūrṇa bhagabān || 357 ||

mallagana dekhe — the wrestlers see; yena vajra-niramana — as if [He] were made of thunderbolt; yogigana dekhe — the yogis see; sei purna bhagavan — Him, the complete Bhagavan

357The wrestlers see Him as if made of thunderbolt,
the yogis see Him as the complete Bhagavan,

যদুগণ দেখে যেন কুলের দেবতা ।
অবিদ্বানগণ দেখে বিরাট বিধাতা ॥ ৩৫৮ ॥

yadugaṇa dekhe yena kulera debatā |
abidbānagaṇa dekhe birāṭa bidhātā || 358 ||

yadugana dekhe — the Yadus see; yena kulera devata — as the deity of their clan; avidvana-gana dekhe — the ignorant see; virata vidhata — the universal form, the Creator

358the Yadus see Him as the deity of their clan,
the ignorant as the universal form of the Creator,

গোপগণ দেখে সেই স্বজন-সমান ।
নারীগণ দেখয়ে কন্দর্প মূর্তিমান্ ॥ ৩৫৯ ॥

gopagaṇa dekhe sei sbajana-samāna |
nārīgaṇa dekhaẏe kandarpa mūrtimān || 359 ||

gopagana dekhe — the cowherds see; sei svajana-samana — Him as their own kin; narigana dekhaye — the women see; kandarpa murtiman — Kandarpa embodied

359the cowherds see Him as their own kin,
the women see Kandarpa embodied.

রঙ্গস্থলে দাঁড়াইল যে দুই ভাই ।
যার যেই অনুভব দেখিল সে-ঠাঁই ॥ ৩৬০ ॥

raṅgasthale dāṁṛāila ye dui bhāi |
yāra yei anubhaba dekhila se-ṭhāṁi || 360 ||

rangasthale — in the arena; dandaila ye dui bhai — when the two brothers stood; yara yei anubhava — according to each one's perception; dekhila se-thani — so he saw there

360When the two brothers stood in the arena,
each one saw there according to his own perception.

চাণুর-মুষ্টিক দুই ভাই করে রণ ।
দেখিয়া চমকে রাজা তখনে তখন ॥ ৩৬১ ॥

cāṇura-muṣṭika dui bhāi kare raṇa |
dekhiẏā camake rājā takhane takhana || 361 ||

chanura-mushtika — with Chanura and Mushtika; dui bhai kare rana — the two brothers fight; dekhiya — seeing it; chamake raja takhane takhana — the king starts again and again

361The two brothers fight with Chanura and Mushtika;
seeing it, the king starts again and again.

চাণুর মারিলা কৃষ্ণ—ঘুচিল উৎপাত ।
মুষ্টিক মারিলা রাম—শবদ নির্ঘাত ॥ ৩৬২ ॥

cāṇura mārilā kṛṣṇa—ghucila utpāta |
muṣṭika mārilā rāma—śabada nirghāta || 362 ||

chanura marila krishna — Krishna slew Chanura; ghuchila utpata — the menace ended; mushtika marila rama — Rama slew Mushtika; shabada nirghata — a thunderous crash

362Krishna slew Chanura — the menace was ended;
Rama slew Mushtika — a crash like thunder.

পুনঃ আর মুটকিতে কোটি মল্ল মারে ।
শাল নামে মল্ল কৃষ্ণ মারিল আছাড়ে ॥ ৩৬৩ ॥

punaḥ āra muṭakite koṭi malla māre |
śāla nāme malla kṛṣṇa mārila āchāṛe || 363 ||

punah ara mutakite — and again with His fists; koti malla mare — He slays countless wrestlers; shala name malla — the wrestler named Shala; krishna marila achhade — Krishna slew, dashing him down

363And again with His fists He slays countless wrestlers;
the wrestler named Shala Krishna slew by dashing him down.

ভাঙ্গিলেন এক মঞ্চ চরণের ঘায়ে ।
কৃষ্ণের বিক্রমে মল্ল চৌদিগে পলায়ে ॥ ৩৬৪ ॥

bhāṅgilena eka mañca caraṇera ghāẏe |
kṛṣṇera bikrame malla caudige palāẏe || 364 ||

bhangilena eka mancha — He broke one platform; charanera ghaye — with a kick; krishnera vikrame — at Krishna's might; malla chaudige palaye — the wrestlers flee in all directions

364With a kick He broke one platform;
before Krishna's might the wrestlers flee in all directions.

শীঘ্র আজ্ঞা করে কংস এ সব দেখিয়া ।
রামকৃষ্ণে বাড়ীর বাহির কর নিয়া ॥ ৩৬৫ ॥

śīghra ājñā kare kaṃsa e saba dekhiẏā |
rāmakṛṣṇe bāṛīra bāhira kara niẏā || 365 ||

shighra ajna kare kamsa — Kamsa quickly orders; e saba dekhiya — seeing all this; rama-krishne — Rama and Krishna; badira bahira kara niya — throw Them out

365Seeing all this, Kamsa quickly orders:
'Seize Rama and Krishna and throw Them out!

নন্দ-আদি যতেক গোয়ালা বন্দী কর ।
উগ্রসেন-বসুদেব-দেবকীরে মার ॥ ৩৬৬ ॥

nanda-ādi yateka goẏālā bandī kara |
ugrasena-basudeba-debakīre māra || 366 ||

nanda-adi yateka goyala — all the cowherds headed by Nanda; bandi kara — imprison; ugrasena-vasudeva-devakire — Ugrasena, Vasudeva and Devaki; mara — kill

366Put all the cowherds headed by Nanda in fetters,
kill Ugrasena, Vasudeva and Devaki!'

হেনকালে কৃষ্ণচন্দ্র সময় বুঝিয়া ।
মহাদর্পে উঠিলা মঞ্চেতে লাফ দিয়া ॥ ৩৬৭ ॥

henakāle kṛṣṇacandra samaẏa bujhiẏā |
mahādarpe uṭhilā mañcete lāpha diẏā || 367 ||

henakale — at that moment; krishnachandra samaya bujhiya — Krishnachandra, seeing the time had come; mahadarpe — with great daring; uthila manchete lapha diya — leapt up onto the platform

367At that moment Krishnachandra, seeing the time had come,
with great daring leapt up onto the platform in one bound.

আস্তে-ব্যস্তে কংস খড়্গ ধরিবার কালে ।
হুহুঙ্কার দিয়া কৃষ্ণ ধরে তার চুলে ॥ ৩৬৮ ॥

āste-byaste kaṃsa khaṛga dharibāra kāle |
huhuṅkāra diẏā kṛṣṇa dhare tāra cule || 368 ||

aste-vyaste — in haste; kamsa khadga dharibara kale — as Kamsa was seizing his sword; huhunkara diya — with a roar; krishna dhare tara chule — Krishna seizes him by the hair

368As Kamsa was hastily seizing his sword,
Krishna with a roar seized him by the hair.

চুলে ধরি' মঞ্চ হৈতে ফেলিলেন ভূমে ।
বিশ্বরূপ বুকে চড়ে মঞ্চের পশ্চিমে ॥ ৩৬৯ ॥

cule dhari' mañca haite phelilena bhūme |
biśbarūpa buke caṛe mañcera paścime || 369 ||

chule dhari — seizing by the hair; mancha haite phelilena bhume — He threw him down from the platform to the ground; vishvarupa buke chade — the Vishvarupa (the Lord whose form is the universe) mounts [his] chest; manchera pashchime — west of the platform

369Seizing him by the hair He threw him from the platform to the ground, and the Vishvarupa — [the Lord whose form is the universe] — mounted his chest west of the platform.

ছাড়িলেক প্রাণ কংস বিশ্বরূপের ভরে ।
ধন্য কংসরাজ—কৃষ্ণ বুকের উপরে ॥ ৩৭০ ॥

chāṛileka prāṇa kaṃsa biśbarūpera bhare |
dhanya kaṃsarāja—kṛṣṇa bukera upare || 370 ||

chhadileka prana kamsa — Kamsa gave up his life; vishvarupera bhare — under the weight of the Vishvarupa; dhanya kamsa-raja — blessed is King Kamsa; krishna bukera upare — Krishna on [his] chest

370Under the weight of the Vishvarupa Kamsa gave up his life.
Blessed is King Kamsa — Krishna is on his chest!7

কংসবধ কৈলা—লোকে বোলে জয় জয় ।
আনন্দে দেবতা সব পুষ্প বরিষয় ॥ ৩৭১ ॥

kaṃsabadha kailā—loke bole jaẏa jaẏa |
ānande debatā saba puṣpa bariṣaẏa || 371 ||

kamsa-vadha kaila — He slew Kamsa; loke bole jaya jaya — the people cry "Victory, victory!"; anande devata saba — joyfully all the gods; pushpa varishaya — rain down flowers

371He slew Kamsa — the people cry: 'Victory, victory!' —
and all the gods joyfully rain down flowers [on Him].

হেঁচুড়ি' আনিল কৃষ্ণ চুলেতে ধরিয়া ।
কথোদূরে ফেলাইলা তুলি' আছাড়িয়া ॥ ৩৭২ ॥

heṁcuṛi' ānila kṛṣṇa culete dhariẏā |
kathodūre phelāilā tuli' āchāṛiẏā || 372 ||

henchudi anila krishna — Krishna dragged [him]; chulete dhariya — holding him by the hair; kathodure phelaila — threw him some distance; tuli achhadiya — lifting and dashing him down

372Holding him by the hair, Krishna dragged him along,
lifted him and, dashing him down, threw him some distance away.

কঙ্ক-আদি করি' কংসের অষ্ট সহোদর ।
ভ্রাতৃশোকে উনমত সভে ধরে বল ॥ ৩৭৩ ॥

kaṅka-ādi kari' kaṃsera aṣṭa sahodara |
bhrātṛśoke unamata sabhe dhare bala || 373 ||

kanka-adi kari — headed by Kanka; kamsera ashta sahodara — Kamsa's eight brothers; bhratri-shoke unamata — maddened by grief for their brother; sabhe dhare bala — all gathered their strength

373Kamsa's eight brothers, headed by Kanka,
maddened by grief for their brother, gathered all their strength:

রামকৃষ্ণ মারিবারে আইসে সাতজন ।
ভ্রূক্ষেপে মারিলা তাহা একা বলরাম ॥ ৩৭৪ ॥

rāmakṛṣṇa māribāre āise sātajana |
bhrūkṣepe mārilā tāhā ekā balarāma || 374 ||

rama-krishna maribare — to kill Rama and Krishna; aise satajana — seven come on; bhrukshepe marila taha — slew them with a mere frown; eka balarama — Balarama alone

374seven come on to kill Rama and Krishna —
Balarama alone slew them with a mere frown.

কংসে হেঁচুড়ি' এই গ্রাম-মধ্য দিয়া ।
কংসখালি বলি' এই—শুন মন দিয়া ॥ ৩৭৫ ॥

kaṃse heṁcuṛi' ei grāma-madhya diẏā |
kaṃsakhāli bali' ei—śuna mana diẏā || 375 ||

kamse henchudi — dragging Kamsa; ei grama-madhya diya — through this village; kamsakhali bali ei — this is called Kamsa-khali; shuna mana diya — listen attentively

375Through this village [Krishna] dragged Kamsa;
that is why [the place] is called Kamsa-khali — listen attentively.

শ্রমশান্তি কৈল—সে বিশ্রান্তিঘাট নাম ।
কংসনারী-প্রলাপে প্রবোধে বলরাম ॥ ৩৭৬ ॥

śramaśānti kaila—se biśrāntighāṭa nāma |
kaṃsanārī-pralāpe prabodhe balarāma || 376 ||

shrama-shanti kaila — He rested from His fatigue; se vishranti-ghata nama — hence the name Vishranti-ghata; kamsa-nari-pralape — the lamenting wives of Kamsa; prabodhe balarama — Balarama consoles

376[Here] He rested from His fatigue — hence the Vishranti-ghata;
Balarama consoles the lamenting wives of Kamsa8.

তবে নিজ মাতাপিতা করিল মোক্ষণ ।
আনন্দে বিহ্বল তারা করয়ে চুম্বন ॥ ৩৭৭ ॥

tabe nija mātāpitā karila mokṣaṇa |
ānande bihbala tārā karaẏe cumbana || 377 ||

tabe — then; nija mata-pita — His own mother and father; karila mokshana — He set free; anande vihvala tara — they, overwhelmed with joy; karaye chumbana — kiss [Him]

377Then He set free His own mother and father;
overwhelmed with joy, they kiss [Him].

উগ্রসেনে রাজা কৈল, নন্দকে বিদায় ।
এ কথা আমার শক্তে কহনে না যায় ॥ ৩৭৮ ॥

ugrasene rājā kaila, nandake bidāẏa |
e kathā āmāra śakte kahane nā yāẏa || 378 ||

ugrasene raja kaila — He made Ugrasena king; nandake vidaya — sent Nanda away; e katha — this account; amara shakte kahane na yaya — is beyond my power to tell

378He made Ugrasena king and sent Nanda away [home] —
this is beyond my power to tell.

কৃষ্ণের নিঠুরপনা শুনিতে তরাস ।
কহিতে মরয়ে, কহে এ লোচনদাস ॥ ৩৭৯ ॥

kṛṣṇera niṭhurapanā śunite tarāsa |
kahite maraẏe, kahe e locanadāsa || 379 ||

krishnera nithurapana — Krishna's hardness of heart; shunite tarasa — is dreadful to hear; kahite maraye — in telling it he dies; kahe e lochanadasa — says this Lochana Dasa

379Krishna's hardness of heart is dreadful even to hear of9:
in telling it he dies [of grief], says this Lochana Dasa.

Raga bhatiyali; disha: "Come, come — I will take Kanai and Balai in my arms!"

তবে বসুদেব পিতা দেবকী জননী ।
এ দোঁহার প্রেমসুখে ভরিল ধরণী ॥ ৩৭৯+১ ॥

tabe basudeba pitā debakī jananī |
e doṁhāra premasukhe bharila dharaṇī || 379+1 ||

tabe — then; vasudeva pita devaki janani — the father Vasudeva and the mother Devaki; e donhara prema-sukhe — with the joy of love of these two; bharila dharani — the earth was filled

379+1Then the father Vasudeva and the mother Devaki —
with the joy of the love of these two the earth was filled10.

পুত্রে উপবীত দিয়া গায়ত্রী শিখায় ।
কতদিন মথুরাতে বিলাসে গোঙায় ॥ ৩৭৯+২ ॥

putre upabīta diẏā gāẏatrī śikhāẏa |
katadina mathurāte bilāse goṅāẏa || 379+2 ||

putre upavita diya — giving the sons the sacred thread; gayatri shikhaya — he teaches [them] the gayatri; katadina mathurate — some days in Mathura; vilase gongaya — [They] pass in pastimes

379+2He gave his sons the sacred thread and teaches [them] the gayatri;
for some time [They] pass Their days in pastimes in Mathura.

কহিতে কৃষ্ণের কথা প্রায়ে অপার ।
সম্বরণ নহে, পুঁথি হয়ে ত বিস্তার ॥ ৩৭৯+৩ ॥

kahite kṛṣṇera kathā prāẏe apāra |
sambaraṇa nahe, puṁthi haẏe ta bistāra || 379+3 ||

kahite krishnera katha — the telling of Krishna's story; praye apara — is almost boundless; samvarana nahe — there is no restraining it; punthi haye ta vistara — the book grows too long

379+3The tales of Krishna are almost without end;
there is no holding back — and the book grows too long.

অক্রূর যতন করে নিজঘরে নিতে ।
বলিল তাহারে—যাব লেউটি' আসিতে ॥ ৩৮০ ॥

akrūra yatana kare nijaghare nite |
balila tāhāre—yāba leuṭi' āsite || 380 ||

akrura yatana kare — Akrura tries; nija-ghare nite — to take [Them] to his house; balila tahare — [Krishna] told him; yaba leuti asite — I shall come on the way back

380Akrura tried to take [Them] to his house;
[Krishna] told him: "I shall come on the way back"11.

কৃষ্ণের বিলম্বে গোপ মথুরা-নিকটে ।
সরস্বতী-তীরে তথা রাখিল শকটে ॥ ৩৮১ ॥

kṛṣṇera bilambe gopa mathurā-nikaṭe |
sarasbatī-tīre tathā rākhila śakaṭe || 381 ||

krishnera vilambe — while Krishna lingered; gopa mathura-nikate — the cowherds near Mathura; sarasvati-tire tatha — there on the bank of the Sarasvati; rakhila shakate — halted the carts

381While Krishna lingered, the cowherds, near Mathura,
halted their carts there on the bank of the Sarasvati.

নন্দ-আদি গোপ যত রাখি' এইখানে ।
আগেতে জানায় কংসে অক্রূর আপনে ॥ ৩৮২ ॥

nanda-ādi gopa yata rākhi' eikhāne |
āgete jānāẏa kaṃse akrūra āpane || 382 ||

nanda-adi gopa yata — all the cowherds headed by Nanda; rakhi eikhane — leaving here; agete janaya kamse — informs Kamsa in advance; akrura apane — Akrura himself

382Leaving the cowherds headed by Nanda here,
Akrura himself goes ahead to inform Kamsa.

বুঝি' এইখানে স্থিতি হৈব কথোক্ষণ ।
মথুরা দেখিতে দুই ভাইর গমন ॥ ৩৮৩ ॥

bujhi' eikhāne sthiti haiba kathokṣaṇa |
mathurā dekhite dui bhāira gamana || 383 ||

bujhi — understanding; eikhane sthiti haiba kathokshana — that there would be a halt here for a while; mathura dekhite — to see Mathura; dui bhaira gamana — the two brothers went

383Understanding that they would stay here for a while,
the two brothers went to see Mathura.

দেখিল রজক এক, দুর্মুখ তার নাম ।
দেখিয়া কাপড় মাগে কৃষ্ণ-বলরাম ॥ ৩৮৪ ॥

dekhila rajaka eka, durmukha tāra nāma |
dekhiẏā kāpaṛa māge kṛṣṇa-balarāma || 384 ||

dekhila rajaka eka — they saw a washerman; durmukha tara nama — named Durmukha; dekhiya — seeing him; kapada mage krishna-balarama — Krishna and Balarama ask for clothes

384They saw a washerman named Durmukha;
seeing him, Krishna and Balarama ask for clothes.

দুর্মুখ পাপিষ্ঠ সেই বোলে দুরক্ষর ।
করাগ্রে কাটিয়া তার ফেলিল কন্ধর ॥ ৩৮৫ ॥

durmukha pāpiṣṭha sei bole durakṣara |
karāgre kāṭiẏā tāra phelila kandhara || 385 ||

durmukha papishtha sei — that sinful Durmukha; bole durakshara — speaks harsh words; karagre katiya — cutting with His fingertips; tara phelila kandhara — He struck off his head

385The sinful Durmukha speaks harsh words —
and [Krishna] struck off his head with His fingertips.

সেই দিব্য বস্ত্র পরি' সুখে হরষিতে ।
সুদামা-মালীর ঘরে ভেল উপনীতে ॥ ৩৮৬ ॥

sei dibya bastra pari' sukhe haraṣite |
sudāmā-mālīra ghare bhela upanīte || 386 ||

sei divya vastra pari — putting on those fine clothes; sukhe harashite — happy and joyful; sudama-malira ghare — at the house of Sudama the garland-maker; bhela upanite — arrived

386Putting on those fine clothes, happy and joyful,
They arrived at the house of Sudama the garland-maker.

সুদামা উঠিয়া কৈল চরণ-বন্দন ।
দিব্য মালা গলে দিয়া করয়ে স্তবন ॥ ৩৮৭ ॥

sudāmā uṭhiẏā kaila caraṇa-bandana |
dibya mālā gale diẏā karaẏe stabana || 387 ||

sudama uthiya — Sudama, rising; kaila charana-vandana — bowed to [Their] feet; divya mala gale diya — placing fine garlands on [Their] necks; karaye stavana — offers praise

387Sudama rose, bowed to Their feet,
placed fine garlands on Their necks and offers praise.

তার পূজা লইয়া চলিলা দুই ভাই ।
ত্রিবক্রা কুবুজী এক দেখিলা তথাই ॥ ৩৮৮ ॥

tāra pūjā laiẏā calilā dui bhāi |
tribakrā kubujī eka dekhilā tathāi || 388 ||

tara puja laiya — accepting his worship; chalila dui bhai — the two brothers went on; trivakra kubuji eka — a hunchbacked woman bent in three places; dekhila tathai — they saw there

388Accepting his worship, the two brothers went on
and saw there a hunchbacked woman bent in three places.

ত্রিবক্রা দেখিয়া মনে হাস্য উপজিল ।
উপহাস করি' তারে আইস আইস বৈল ॥ ৩৮৯ ॥

tribakrā dekhiẏā mane hāsya upajila |
upahāsa kari' tāre āisa āisa baila || 389 ||

trivakra dekhiya — seeing the bent woman; mane hasya upajila — laughter arose in His mind; upahasa kari — jesting; tare aisa aisa baila — He said to her "Come, come"

389Seeing the bent woman, [Krishna] laughed within
and in jest said to her: "Come, come."

আদরে দোঁহারে কুব্জা নিজঘরে নিল ।
অগুরু-চন্দন-গন্ধ শ্রীঅঙ্গে লেপিল ॥ ৩৯০ ॥

ādare doṁhāre kubjā nijaghare nila |
aguru-candana-gandha śrīaṅge lepila || 390 ||

adare donhare — with honour both; kubja nija-ghare nila — Kubja took to her house; aguru-chandana-gandha — fragrant aloe and sandal; sri-ange lepila — she applied to [Their] bodies

390Kubja with honour took both to her house
and anointed Their bodies with fragrant aloe and sandal.

বড় তুষ্ট হঞা কুব্জী সৎকার করিল ।
শ্রীহস্ত-পরশে কুব্জা দিব্যমূর্তি হৈল ॥ ৩৯১ ॥

baṛa tuṣṭa hañā kubjī satkāra karila |
śrīhasta-paraśe kubjā dibyamūrti haila || 391 ||

bada tushta hanya — greatly pleased; kubji satkara karila — Kubja paid honour; sri-hasta-parashe — by the touch of the holy hand; kubja divya-murti haila — Kubja gained a beautiful form

391Greatly pleased, Kubja paid Them honour —
and by the touch of the holy hand Kubja gained a beautiful form.

কামে অচেতন কুব্জা চাহে কানু-পানে ।
লজ্জা পরিহরি' কহে বেকত-বদনে ॥ ৩৯২ ॥

kāme acetana kubjā cāhe kānu-pāne |
lajjā parihari' kahe bekata-badane || 392 ||

kame achetana kubja — Kubja, senseless with desire; chahe kanu-pane — looks at Kanu; lajja parihari — casting off shame; kahe vekata-vadane — speaks openly

392Senseless with desire, Kubja looks at Kanu
and, casting off shame, speaks openly12.

আশ্বাস-বচনে তারে তুষ্ট কৈল হরি ।
চলিলা ত দুই ভাই নটবেশ ধরি' ॥ ৩৯৩ ॥

āśbāsa-bacane tāre tuṣṭa kaila hari |
calilā ta dui bhāi naṭabeśa dhari' || 393 ||

ashvasa-vachane — with words of assurance; tare tushta kaila hari — Hari pleased her; chalila ta dui bhai — the two brothers went on; natavesha dhari — in the attire of dancers

393With words of assurance Hari pleased her,
and the two brothers went on in the attire of dancers.

তবে ধনুর্যজ্ঞ-স্থানে ধনুক ভাঙ্গিলা ।
কংস-অনুচর যত মারিতে ধাইলা ॥ ৩৯৪ ॥

tabe dhanuryajña-sthāne dhanuka bhāṅgilā |
kaṃsa-anucara yata mārite dhāilā || 394 ||

tabe — then; dhanur-yajna-sthane — at the place of the bow sacrifice; dhanuka bhangila — He broke the bow; kamsa-anuchara yata — all Kamsa's men; marite dhaila — rushed to kill [Them]

394Then at the place of the bow sacrifice [Krishna] broke the bow;
all Kamsa's men rushed to kill [Them],

ভগ্নধনু হাতে করি' কংসচর মারি' ।
সন্ধ্যায় চলিলা যথা নন্দ আদি করি' ॥ ৩৯৫ ॥

bhagnadhanu hāte kari' kaṃsacara māri' |
sandhyāẏa calilā yathā nanda ādi kari' || 395 ||

bhagna-dhanu hate kari — taking the broken bow in hand; kamsa-chara mari — slaying Kamsa's men; sandhyaya chalila — at dusk they went; yatha nanda adi kari — to where Nanda and the others were

395but, taking the broken bow in hand, [They] slew Kamsa's men
and at dusk went to where Nanda and the others [were].

সেই ত রজনী কংস কুস্বপ্ন দেখিল ।
অতি উচ্চতর করি' এ মঞ্চ বান্ধিল ॥ ৩৯৬ ॥

sei ta rajanī kaṃsa kusbapna dekhila |
ati uccatara kari' e mañca bāndhila || 396 ||

sei ta rajani — that very night; kamsa kusvapna dekhila — Kamsa saw evil dreams; ati uchchatara kari — making it very high; e mancha bandhila — he built this platform

396That very night Kamsa had evil dreams;
he built this very high platform.

ইহার দক্ষিণে হের দুই মঞ্চ আর ।
বসুদেব-দেবকীর তরে বসিবার ॥ ৩৯৭ ॥

ihāra dakṣiṇe hera dui mañca āra |
basudeba-debakīra tare basibāra || 397 ||

ihara dakshine — south of it; hera dui mancha ara — here are two more platforms; vasudeva-devakira tare — for Vasudeva and Devaki; basibara — to sit on

397Here, south of it, are two more platforms
for Vasudeva and Devaki to sit on:

কালি হেথা রামকৃষ্ণ মরিবে আসিয়া ।
পুত্র-মৃত্যু দেখে যেন এথাতে বসিয়া ॥ ৩৯৮ ॥

kāli hethā rāmakṛṣṇa maribe āsiẏā |
putra-mṛtyu dekhe yena ethāte basiẏā || 398 ||

kali hetha — tomorrow here; rama-krishna maribe asiya — Rama and Krishna will come and die; putra-mrityu dekhe yena — let them see their sons' death; ethate basiya — sitting here

398"Tomorrow Rama and Krishna will come here and die —
let them sit here and see their sons' death!"

চৌদিগে পাত্র-মিত্র সভে কৈল মঞ্চ ।
অবিকল মল্লযুদ্ধ দেখিতে সুসঞ্চ ॥ ৩৯৯ ॥

caudige pātra-mitra sabhe kaila mañca |
abikala mallayuddha dekhite susañca || 399 ||

chaudige — all around; patra-mitra sabhe kaila mancha — all the ministers and friends set up platforms; avikala mallayuddha dekhite — to see the wrestling in every detail; susancha — well arranged

399All around, all the ministers and friends set up platforms,
well arranged, to watch the wrestling in every detail.

পশ্চিমে খনিল কূপ সেই ত পামরে ।
দুই ভাই মারি' তাথে ফেলিবার তরে ॥ ৪০০ ॥

paścime khanila kūpa sei ta pāmare |
dui bhāi māri' tāthe phelibāra tare || 400 ||

pashchime — to the west; khanila kupa sei ta pamare — that villain dug a well; dui bhai mari — killing the two brothers; tathe phelibara tare — to throw Them in it

400To the west that villain dug a well,
to kill the two brothers and throw Them in it13.

প্রভাতে উঠিয়া মঞ্চে বৈসে কংসরাজ ।
আনহ গোয়ালা সব—দেউক রাজ-কাজ ॥ ৪০১ ॥

prabhāte uṭhiẏā mañce baise kaṃsarāja |
ānaha goẏālā saba—deuka rāja-kāja || 401 ||

prabhate uthiya — rising in the morning; manche baise kamsaraja — King Kamsa sits on the platform; anaha goyala saba — bring all the cowherds; deuka raja-kaja — let them pay the royal dues

401Rising in the morning, King Kamsa sits on the platform:
"Bring all the cowherds — let them pay the royal dues!

তার দুই পুত্র আন—কৃষ্ণ-বলরাম ।
ভাল শুনিঞাছি, তার দেখিব সংগ্রাম ॥ ৪০২ ॥

tāra dui putra āna—kṛṣṇa-balarāma |
bhāla śuniñāchi, tāra dekhiba saṃgrāma || 402 ||

tara dui putra ana — bring his two sons; krishna-balarama — Krishna and Balarama; bhala shuninyachhi — I have heard much; tara dekhiba sangrama — I will watch Them fight

402Bring his two sons, Krishna and Balarama:
I have heard much of Them; I will watch Them fight."

ধাইল সে ধাওয়া সব রাজার আজ্ঞায় ।
সংগ্রামের শব্দ শুনি' রামকৃষ্ণ ধায় ॥ ৪০৩ ॥

dhāila se dhāoẏā saba rājāra ājñāẏa |
saṃgrāmera śabda śuni' rāmakṛṣṇa dhāẏa || 403 ||

dhaila se dhaoya saba — all the runners ran; rajara ajnaya — at the king's order; sangramera shabda shuni — hearing the din of the contest; rama-krishna dhaya — Rama and Krishna hasten

403At the king's order all the runners ran;
hearing the din of the contest, Rama and Krishna hasten [there].

সত্বরে চলিয়া গেলা গড়ের দুয়ার ।
গড়দ্বারে গজ আছে পর্বত-আকার ॥ ৪০৪ ॥

satbare caliẏā gelā gaṛera duẏāra |
gaṛadbāre gaja āche parbata-ākāra || 404 ||

satvare chaliya gela — they quickly went; gadera duyara — to the gate of the fort; gada-dvare — at the fort gate; gaja achhe parvata-akara — stands an elephant the size of a mountain

404They quickly went to the gate of the fort —
and at the gate of the fort stands an elephant the size of a mountain.

রামকৃষ্ণ দেখি' রুষি' আইসে মারিবার ।
রুষিয়া রহিলা কৃষ্ণ সম্মুখে তাহার ॥ ৪০৫ ॥

rāmakṛṣṇa dekhi' ruṣi' āise māribāra |
ruṣiẏā rahilā kṛṣṇa sammukhe tāhāra || 405 ||

rama-krishna dekhi — seeing Rama and Krishna; rushi aise maribara — it charges in fury to kill [Them]; rushiya rahila krishna — angered, Krishna stood; sammukhe tahara — before it

405Seeing Rama and Krishna, it charges in fury to kill [Them];
angered, Krishna stood before it.

শুণ্ডে ধরি' ঠেলাঠেলি চড়ে তার কান্ধে ।
মাহুত মারিয়া টান দিল গজদন্তে ॥ ৪০৬ ॥

śuṇḍe dhari' ṭhelāṭheli caṛe tāra kāndhe |
māhuta māriẏā ṭāna dila gajadante || 406 ||

shunde dhari — seizing the trunk; thelatheli — in the struggle; chade tara kandhe — He climbs onto its neck; mahuta mariya — killing the driver; tana dila gaja-dante — He wrenched the elephant's tusks

406Seizing its trunk, in the struggle [He] climbs onto its neck,
kills the driver and wrenches the elephant's tusks.

দন্ত উপাড়িয়া পুচ্ছ ধরিয়া ঘুরায় ।
আকাশে তুলিয়া চারি-যোজন ফেলায় ॥ ৪০৭ ॥

danta upāṛiẏā puccha dhariẏā ghurāẏa |
ākāśe tuliẏā cāri-yojana phelāẏa || 407 ||

danta upadiya — tearing out the tusks; puchchha dhariya ghuraya — seizing the tail, He whirls it; akashe tuliya — lifting it into the air; chari-yojana phelaya — He hurls it four yojanas away

407Tearing out the tusks, He seizes it by the tail, whirls it round,
lifts it into the air and hurls it four yojanas away.

পড়িল ত মহাগজ—শুনে কংসরায় ।
কাঁপিতে লাগিল অঙ্গ, তরাস হিয়ায় ॥ ৪০৮ ॥

paṛila ta mahāgaja—śune kaṃsarāẏa |
kāṁpite lāgila aṅga, tarāsa hiẏāẏa || 408 ||

padila ta mahagaja — the great elephant has fallen; shune kamsaraya — King Kamsa hears; kanpite lagila anga — his body began to tremble; tarasa hiyaya — fear in his heart

408"The great elephant has fallen!" — King Kamsa hears;
his body began to tremble, fear in his heart.

তবে রামকৃষ্ণ গেলা রাজার সম্মুখে ।
তরাসে গোয়ালা সব কাঁপি' হালে বুকে ॥ ৪০৯ ॥

tabe rāmakṛṣṇa gelā rājāra sammukhe |
tarāse goẏālā saba kāṁpi' hāle buke || 409 ||

tabe rama-krishna — then Rama and Krishna; gela rajara sammukhe — went before the king; tarase goyala saba — all the cowherds in fear; kanpi hale buke — tremble, their hearts pounding

409Then Rama and Krishna went before the king;
all the cowherds tremble in fear, their hearts pounding.

চাণুর-মুষ্টিকে বোলে কংসের বচন ।
মল্লযুদ্ধ দেখিবারে ভেল মোর মন ॥ ৪১০ ॥

cāṇura-muṣṭike bole kaṃsera bacana |
mallayuddha dekhibāre bhela mora mana || 410 ||

chanura-mushtike — to Chanura and Mushtika; bole kamsera vachana — Kamsa speaks; mallayuddha dekhibare — to see a wrestling match; bhela mora mana — I have a mind

410Kamsa says to Chanura and Mushtika:
"I have a mind to watch a wrestling match."

এইখানে মল্লযুদ্ধ ভেল মহারণে ।
চাণুর সহিতে কৃষ্ণ, মুষ্টিক বলরামে ॥ ৪১১ ॥

eikhāne mallayuddha bhela mahāraṇe |
cāṇura sahite kṛṣṇa, muṣṭika balarāme || 411 ||

eikhane — here; mallayuddha bhela maharane — the wrestling took place in great combat; chanura sahite krishna — Krishna with Chanura; mushtika balarame — Mushtika with Balarama

411Here took place the great combat of the wrestlers:
Krishna with Chanura, Balarama with Mushtika.

সেই বৃন্দাবন-পুরন্দর কলিযুগে ।
তখনে যে কৈল গাথা—কহি, শুন এবে ॥ ৪১২ ॥

sei bṛndābana-purandara kaliyuge |
takhane ye kaila gāthā—kahi, śuna ebe || 412 ||

sei vrindavana-purandara — that Lord of Vrindavana; kaliyuge — in the Kali age; takhane ye kaila gatha — the story of what He did then; kahi shuna ebe — I tell, hear now

412That Lord of Vrindavana [appeared] in the Kali age;
what He did then I shall tell — hear now14.

প্রদক্ষিণ কৈল গোরা মথুরামণ্ডল ।
মহাজন কৃষ্ণদাস জানাইলা সকল ॥ ৪১৩ ॥

pradakṣiṇa kaila gorā mathurāmaṇḍala |
mahājana kṛṣṇadāsa jānāilā sakala || 413 ||

pradakshina kaila gora — Gora circumambulated; mathura-mandala — the Mathura-mandala; mahajana krishnadasa — the great Krishnadasa; janaila sakala — made everything known

413Gora circumambulated the Mathura-mandala;
the great Krishnadasa made everything known to Him.

প্রভুরে বিনয় করে চরণে পড়িয়া ।
মো অতি কাতর—মোরে না যাহ ভাঁড়িয়া ॥ ৪১৪ ॥

prabhure binaẏa kare caraṇe paṛiẏā |
mo ati kātara—more nā yāha bhāṁṛiẏā || 414 ||

prabhure vinaya kare — he humbly entreats the Lord; charane padiya — falling at His feet; mo ati katara — I am in great distress; more na yaha bhandiya — do not go away deceiving me

414He humbly entreats the Lord, falling at His feet:
"I am in great distress — do not go away, deceiving me!

তুমি সেই কৃষ্ণ—এই জানিলুঁ নিশ্চয় ।
প্রসাদ কর মোরে, শুন গোরারায় ॥ ৪১৫ ॥

tumi sei kṛṣṇa—ei jāniluṁ niścaẏa |
prasāda kara more, śuna gorārāẏa || 415 ||

tumi sei krishna — You are that Krishna; ei janilun nishchaya — this I have known for certain; prasada kara more — show me grace; shuna goraraya — hear, Goraraya

415You are that very Krishna — this I have known for certain;
show me grace, hear me, Goraraya!"

এ বোল শুনিয়া প্রভু বোলয়ে বচন ।
তোর পরসাদে মোর শুদ্ধ হৈল মন ॥ ৪১৬ ॥

e bola śuniẏā prabhu bolaẏe bacana |
tora parasāde mora śuddha haila mana || 416 ||

e bola shuniya — hearing this; prabhu bolaye vachana — the Lord speaks; tora parasade — by your grace; mora shuddha haila mana — My mind has been purified

416Hearing this, the Lord speaks:
"By your grace My mind has been purified.

মথুরা দেখিব বলি' বড় ছিল সাধ ।
দেখিলুঁ রহস্য-স্থান তোর পরসাদ ॥ ৪১৭ ॥

mathurā dekhiba bali' baṛa chila sādha |
dekhiluṁ rahasya-sthāna tora parasāda || 417 ||

mathura dekhiba bali — to see Mathura; bada chhila sadha — was My great desire; dekhilun rahasya-sthana — I have seen the secret places; tora parasada — by your grace

417I had a great desire to see Mathura —
by your grace I have seen the secret places.

আমার যেমন হিয়া হইল উল্লাস ।
কৃষ্ণ পরসন্ন তোরে হউ, কৃষ্ণদাস ॥ ৪১৮ ॥

āmāra yemana hiẏā haila ullāsa |
kṛṣṇa parasanna tore hau, kṛṣṇadāsa || 418 ||

amara yemana hiya — as My heart; haila ullasa — has rejoiced; krishna parasanna tore hau — may Krishna be pleased with you; krishnadasa — Krishnadasa

418As My heart has rejoiced,
[so] may Krishna be gracious to you, Krishnadasa!"

মথুরামণ্ডলবাসী যত সর্বলোক ।
গৌরচন্দ্র দেখিবারে ভেল একমুখ ॥ ৪১৯ ॥

mathurāmaṇḍalabāsī yata sarbaloka |
gauracandra dekhibāre bhela ekamukha || 419 ||

mathura-mandala-vasi — the residents of the Mathura-mandala; yata sarvaloka — all the people; gaurachandra dekhibare — to see Gaurachandra; bhela ekamukha — all turned one way

419All the residents of the Mathura-mandala
all turned one way — to see Gaurachandra.

বারেক দেখয়ে যেই নারে পাসরিতে ।
প্রেমায় বিহ্বল সেই নারে সম্বরিতে ॥ ৪২০ ॥

bāreka dekhaẏe yei nāre pāsarite |
premāẏa bihbala sei nāre sambarite || 420 ||

bareka dekhaye yei — whoever sees [Him] once; nare pasarite — cannot forget; premaya vihvala sei — he, overwhelmed with prema; nare samvarite — cannot contain himself

420Whoever sees Him once cannot forget Him;
overwhelmed with prema, he cannot contain himself.

বাল বৃদ্ধ কিবা যুবা এ নারী পুরুখ ।
কৃষ্ণ এই, কৃষ্ণ এই—বোলয়ে মুরুখ ॥ ৪২১ ॥

bāla bṛddha kibā yubā e nārī purukha |
kṛṣṇa ei, kṛṣṇa ei—bolaẏe murukha || 421 ||

bala vriddha kiba yuva — children, old and young; e nari purukha — women and men; krishna ei krishna ei — this is Krishna, this is Krishna; bolaye murukha — even the unlettered say

421Children, old and young, women and men —
even the unlettered — say: "This is Krishna, this is Krishna!

এতদিনে কৃষ্ণ পুনঃ আইলা মথুরারে ।
পুরুব-রহস্য-স্থান দেখিবার তরে ॥ ৪২২ ॥

etadine kṛṣṇa punaḥ āilā mathurāre |
puruba-rahasya-sthāna dekhibāra tare || 422 ||

etadine — at last; krishna punah aila mathurare — Krishna has come to Mathura again; puruba-rahasya-sthana — the secret places of old; dekhibara tare — in order to see

422At last Krishna has come to Mathura again
to see the secret places of His former [pastimes]."

কেহো বোলে—ত্রিভঙ্গ হইয়া কেনে থাকে ।
কানাই না হৈলে কেনে রাধা বলি' ডাকে ॥ ৪২৩ ॥

keho bole—tribhaṅga haiẏā kene thāke |
kānāi nā haile kene rādhā bali' ḍāke || 423 ||

keho bole — someone says; tribhanga haiya kene thake — why does He stand thrice-bent; kanai na haile — if He is not Kanai; kene radha bali dake — why does He call "Radha!"

423Someone says: "Why does He stand thrice-bent?
If He is not Kanai, why does He call 'Radha!'?"15

রাত্রি দিবা থাকে লোক, না ছাড়য়ে কাছ ।
একে একে দেখে প্রভু বৃন্দাবনের গাছ ॥ ৪২৪ ॥

rātri dibā thāke loka, nā chāṛaẏe kācha |
eke eke dekhe prabhu bṛndābanera gācha || 424 ||

ratri diva thake loka — people stay day and night; na chhadaye kachha — they do not leave His side; eke eke dekhe prabhu — one by one the Lord sees; vrindavanera gachha — the trees of Vrindavana

424People stay with Him day and night and do not leave His side;
one by one the Lord looks at the trees of Vrindavana.

একে একে সব স্থান নিরীখে ঠাকুর ।
এইখানে বনে সব প্রেম পরিপূর ॥ ৪২৫ ॥

eke eke saba sthāna nirīkhe ṭhākura |
eikhāne bane saba prema paripūra || 425 ||

eke eke saba sthana — one by one all the places; nirikhe thakura — the Thakura beholds; eikhane vane — here in the forests; saba prema paripura — all is filled with prema

425One by one the Thakura beholds all the places:
here, in the forests, all is filled with prema.

মথুরামণ্ডলে ঘরে ঘরে পরকাশ ।
কেহো শিশু দেখে, কেহো যুবক-বিলাস ॥ ৪২৬ ॥

mathurāmaṇḍale ghare ghare parakāśa |
keho śiśu dekhe, keho yubaka-bilāsa || 426 ||

mathura-mandale — in the Mathura-mandala; ghare ghare parakasha — [He] is manifest in every house; keho shishu dekhe — some see a Child; keho yuvaka-vilasa — some the pastimes of a Youth

426In the Mathura-mandala He is manifest in every house:
some see a Child, some the pastimes of a Youth.

কেহো আচম্বিতে ঘরে শুনে বংশীনাদ ।
কারু স্বামি-কোলে কৃষ্ণরসের উন্মাদ ॥ ৪২৭ ॥

keho ācambite ghare śune baṃśīnāda |
kāru sbāmi-kole kṛṣṇarasera unmāda || 427 ||

keho achambite — someone suddenly; ghare shune vamshi-nada — hears at home the sound of the flute; karu svami-kole — for one, in her husband's embrace; krishna-rasera unmada — the madness of Krishna-rasa

427Someone at home suddenly hears the sound of the flute;
for one, in her husband's embrace — the madness of Krishna-rasa16.

কারু পর-বুদ্ধি নাহি, সভে বোলে নিজ ।
সভার হৃদয়ে উপজিল প্রেমবীজ ॥ ৪২৮ ॥

kāru para-buddhi nāhi, sabhe bole nija |
sabhāra hṛdaẏe upajila premabīja || 428 ||

karu para-buddhi nahi — no one thinks [Him] a stranger; sabhe bole nija — all say "[He is] our own"; sabhara hridaye — in the hearts of all; upajila prema-bija — the seed of prema sprouted

428No one thinks Him a stranger — all say: "[He is] our own";
in the hearts of all the seed of prema sprouted.

বন বেড়াইতে বনে প্রভু যায় যবে ।
সে বনের তরু-লতা ভাসে প্রেম-দ্রবে ॥ ৪২৯ ॥

bana beṛāite bane prabhu yāẏa yabe |
se banera taru-latā bhāse prema-drabe || 429 ||

vana bedaite — to roam the forests; vane prabhu yaya yabe — when the Lord goes into a forest; se vanera taru-lata — the trees and creepers of that forest; bhase prema-drave — float in the flood of prema

429When the Lord goes roaming in the forests,
the trees and creepers of that forest float in the flood of prema.

কোকিল ভ্রমর ময়ূর বুলে মাঠে গোঠে ।
ধাওয়াধাই আইসে, রহে প্রভুর নিকটে ॥ ৪৩০ ॥

kokila bhramara maẏūra bule māṭhe goṭhe |
dhāoẏādhāi āise, rahe prabhura nikaṭe || 430 ||

kokila bhramara mayura — cuckoos, bees, peacocks; bule mathe gothe — roaming fields and pastures; dhaoyadhai aise — come racing; rahe prabhura nikate — stay near the Lord

430Cuckoos, bees, peacocks that roam the fields and pastures
come racing and stay near the Lord.

ঊর্ধ্বমুখে সর্বজন প্রভুমুখ দেখি' ।
সভারে সমান স্নেহ—প্রেমময় আঁখি ॥ ৪৩১ ॥

ūrdhbamukhe sarbajana prabhumukha dekhi' |
sabhāre samāna sneha—premamaẏa āṁkhi || 431 ||

urdhva-mukhe sarvajana — all with upturned faces; prabhu-mukha dekhi — looking at the Lord's face; sabhare samana sneha — equal tenderness for all; premamaya ankhi — eyes full of prema

431All, with upturned faces, look at the Lord's face;
equal tenderness for all, eyes full of prema.

সর্বজন জানিল—এ কপট-সন্ন্যাসী ।
চলিলা ত মহাপ্রভু নীলাচলবাসী ॥ ৪৩২ ॥

sarbajana jānila—e kapaṭa-sannyāsī |
calilā ta mahāprabhu nīlācalabāsī || 432 ||

sarvajana janila — all knew; e kapata-sannyasi — He is a sannyasi only in disguise; chalila ta mahaprabhu — Mahaprabhu set out; nilachala-vasi — the dweller of Nilachala

432All knew: He is a sannyasi only in disguise.
And Mahaprabhu, the dweller of Nilachala, set out on His way.

মথুরামণ্ডল-কথা কহিল এ সায় ।
আনন্দে লোচনদাস গোরাগুণ গায় ॥ ৪৩৩ ॥

mathurāmaṇḍala-kathā kahila e sāẏa |
ānande locanadāsa gorāguṇa gāẏa || 433 ||

mathura-mandala-katha — the account of the Mathura-mandala; kahila e saya — is here concluded; anande lochanadasa — joyfully Lochana Dasa; goraguna gaya — sings Gora's glories

433Here the account of the Mathura-mandala is concluded;
joyfully Lochana Dasa sings Gora's glories.

✦

Notes

  1. Vv. 316–322 follow a Vraja tradition about the Khadira-vana. Madana-Gopala — "the Gopala [who conquers] Madana," the Deity of Krishna in Vrindavana (Madana-mohana). The love of Radha and Krishna is transcendental (aprakrita); cf. en/48, note 10.
  2. Vv. 323–335 follow the Bhagavata (10.34–10.37): the deliverance of the vidyadhara Sudarshana, who swallowed Nanda in Ambika-vana; the killing of Shankhachuda, Arishta, Keshi and Vyomasura; Narada reveals to Kamsa the secret of Krishna's birth. Cf. Murari 4.10.
  3. The "sliding stone" (phisalani-shila) is a holy place of Kamyavana; the Pavana-sarovara is a pond at Nandagrama (Nandishvara).
  4. Vv. 339–353 follow the Bhagavata (10.38–10.39): Akrura comes to Vraja on Kamsa's order, sees the marks of Krishna's feet, at night tells of Kamsa's design; Krishna and Balarama leave for Mathura; the gopis lament; in the waters of the Yamuna Akrura sees Vishnu on Ananta. Cf. Murari 4.11.
  5. Cf. the Bhagavata 10.39.35 and 10.46–10.47 (the message sent with Uddhava).
  6. Vv. 354–360 follow the Bhagavata (10.43.17): each one sees Krishna in the arena according to his own disposition. Vv. 356–360 are absent in the 1983 edition; the 1903 edition gives them in a footnote as an additional reading of one manuscript. In the 1983 edition vv. 380–411 (the way to Mathura, the washerman, Kubja, the bow, the elephant) stand before v. 354, which is more consistent; we keep Bhaktisiddhanta's order. Cf. Murari 4.12.
  7. According to the Bhagavata (10.44.39), Kamsa, who thought of Krishna incessantly, though in fear and enmity, attained liberation. Gaudiya Vaishnavas explain that enemies slain by the Lord receive liberation, but not prema.
  8. In the Bhagavata (10.44) it is Krishna who consoles Kamsa's wives.
  9. That is, that Krishna sent Nanda and the cowherds back to Vraja and Himself remained in Mathura (Bhagavata 10.45): for the Vaishnava poet Vraja's separation from Krishna is the bitterest thing of all.
  10. Vv. 379+1 — 379+3 are absent in Bhaktisiddhanta's edition (1922); they are found in the 1903 edition (here, after v. 379, with a new raga) and in the 1983 edition (before v. 412, since vv. 380–411 are moved earlier there). Cf. the Bhagavata 10.45 (Vasudeva performs the sacred-thread ceremony for his sons).
  11. Vv. 380–411 go back to the arrival of Krishna and Balarama in Mathura (Bhagavata 10.41–10.43): the washerman, Sudama the garland-maker, Kubja, the bow, the elephant Kuvalayapida, the challenge to the wrestling; cf. Murari 4.12. The washerman's name (Durmukha) is not given in the Bhagavata.
  12. Lochana Dasa speaks plainly of Kubja's desire. Gaudiya Vaishnavas (following Rupa Gosvami) distinguish Kubja's love, which contains a desire for her own pleasure (sadharani-rati), from the selfless love of the gopis (samartha-rati); cf. en/49, note 11.
  13. Vv. 396–400 (Kamsa's high platform, the platforms for Vasudeva and Devaki, the well) are details not found in the Bhagavata; cf. the Bhagavata 10.42.26–38 (evil omens, the preparation of the arena).
  14. Lochana Dasa returns to the story of Gaura: that same Krishna, the Lord of Vrindavana, appeared in the Kali age as Gaura.
  15. V. 423 is absent in the 1983 edition; the 1903 edition puts it in brackets as the reading of some manuscripts.
  16. A spiritual experience is meant (the Lord revealing Himself in the heart), not a worldly feeling: the residents of the Mathura-mandala, seeing Gaura, experience Krishna's lilas — one sees the Child, another the Youth, another hears the flute.
